content.what_it_is: MATLAB animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_gen_abs_data simple case. It loads eta_00001 to size the grid [n,m] (L8, L10), builds x,y with dx=dy=2.0 (L11-L14), and computes an analytic 1D depth profile dep(i): flat at -DEPTH_FLAT=-8.0 for x<Xslp=300.0, rising with slope SLP=0.05 beyond (L4-L6, L16-L22). It opens MPEG-4 videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps, quality 100, target 576x1024 (L26-L31), sets jet colormap and an 8x5-inch figure (L33-L36). For each of frames nfile=1..99 (L24, L40): loads eta_<fnum> and mask_<fnum> (L42-L44), NaNs dry cells (L46), draws a 3D mesh with axis [0 x(end) 0 y(end) -2 4] and view(17,16) in subplot 1 (L50-L54), and in subplot 2 plots the mid-row transect eta(floor(n/2),:) together with the analytic depth line dep (L56-L61); labels, zbuffer renderer, pause (L63-L73), rasterizes at 300 dpi, resizes to 576x1024, stores mov(num).cdata and writes the frame (L75-L79). Closes the video at L82. A commented jpeg export naming eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg remains at L86.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
DEPTH_FLAT — flat region depth in meters (L6)
eta — surface elevation array, reloaded per frame (L8, L43)
n, m — grid dimensions from size(eta) (L10)
dep — analytic 1D depth profile (negative down) (L18, L20)
mov — struct array of frame cdata (L77)

equations.ref: analytic plane-slope depth beyond Xslp (negative down)

io.name: two-panel per-frame figure: 3D mesh of eta and mid-row transect with analytic depth line

unresolved: The analytic depth profile (SLP=0.05, Xslp=300, DEPTH_FLAT=8; L4-L6) is asserted to match the case bathymetry; consistency with the tide_gen_abs_data input/depth files cannot be checked from this script.
ylabel ' y (m) ' is set only for num==1 (L63-L65) but clf (L49) clears it each frame; it also lands on the transect subplot (active axes), where the y-axis is eta, not y.
mov(num).cdata accumulates all 99 frames in memory though each is written immediately (L77-L79); the array is never reused.
Frames start at 1 while sizing uses eta_00001 (L8, L24); eta_00000 is skipped without comment.
The commented export name eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg (L86) is copied from another case's script.
